articles.title: Mischtian Leads Race for County Court at Law No
articles.excerpt: In the Nov. 8, 2022 general election, Mischtian, a Republican, led Democrat Kurt Glass in early-voting returns with about 59% of the vote to Glass's 41%, per unofficial results (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: Locals Vying for County Seats in Primary Elections
articles.excerpt: 2026 election: The Killeen Daily Herald listed Mischtian as the uncontested Republican candidate for County Court at Law seat No. 2 in the March 3, 2026 primary (Killeen Daily Herald).
